portfolio precondition + Founder family continuity gate before prose

R50_near_term_12_slot_slate.law: Existing PROJECT_IDs are not renumbered; SAGA_SLOT order is logical architecture, not a command to reorder historical publication numbers.

required: Main hero/want/problem understandable from current book without prior-book synopsis.
Current-book opposition and stakes become legible before franchise history is required.
Essential prior facts are reintroduced through present consequence/action, not recap lecture.
No proper noun is required merely to recognize fandom continuity; reader can understand function before history.
Main conflict closes locally even if civilization/relationship history continues.
R51_standalone_reader_entry_test.context_budget: Target <=5 indispensable prior-saga facts for the main conflict; more may appear as optional texture/reward.
fail_if: main mystery answer depends on an unread earlier climax with no current evidence

R52_saga_reader_reward_test.law: A returning reader may understand more, feel more or predict more, but a new reader must still understand what the current hero wants and why the current choice matters.
R52_saga_reader_reward_test.anti_fan_service: Callback must alter present emotion/decision/evidence or be brief texture; otherwise cut it.

R53_philosophical_repetition_detector.comparison_window: previous 6 books plus previous book in same line
R53_philosophical_repetition_detector.flag: MAJOR if 5+ dimensions are functionally equivalent despite different lore; MEDIUM at 4; below 4 normally distinct subject to Red Team.
R53_philosophical_repetition_detector.important: Repeated civilization question can return later only if protagonist position, evidence, price and institutional context materially change.

R54_power_inflation_detector.flag: Escalation is suspicious when threat/capability grows >=2 ordinal levels while human/civilization question, decision complexity and lasting consequence do not grow/change.
R54_power_inflation_detector.safe_pattern: Later books may be smaller in physical scale but deeper in rights/identity/relationship consequence.
R54_power_inflation_detector.forbidden_default: Every Crossing must be bigger than the prior Crossing.

R55_audio_downstream_contract.feedback_backflow: Audio/human-listener comprehension failure may open a bounded writing review only through evidence -> diagnosis -> minimum effective repair -> story regression; audio preference alone does not reopen canon.

R56_market_accessibility_adapter.routing: Signal -> source/evidence class -> affected decision -> severity -> minimum intervention -> regression -> accept/hold/reject.

aggregate_verdict: PASS_R49_R56; near-term slate remains adaptive and gate-aware
